mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 71 degrees, with the current phase of the moon being a Waning Gibbous over Badger Prairie County Park.

The city of Verona has officially installed a new public art sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School Park. This piece, created by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland, was carved from an ash tree and was made possible by donor Gerri Gurman.

There is plenty to do today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, plus trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly look at local reports, on Monday, August 25, an officer was dispatched to a residence for a medical emergency where they successfully applied an AED to help a patient regain a pulse.
Today's featured flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. Since the store is currently closed, please note that it opens today at 10:00 AM.
